title: Inforsight policy event
description: Shared envelope for an immutable event in a fictional policy history.

schema_version.description: Version of this policy-event envelope contract.

event_id.description: Synthetic identifier for this immutable event.

policy_id.description: Synthetic identifier for the fictional policy.

event_type.description: Stable, namespaced name used to select an event-specific payload contract.

occurred_at.description: UTC instant when the fictional event occurred.

effective_at.description: UTC instant from which the event affects reconstructed policy state.

ingested_at.description: UTC instant when Inforsight learned about the event.

payload.description: Event-specific fictional facts. Later contracts define its fields by event type.
